project.projectTitle: The Biggest Show in the World (According to Mom)

vision.concept: Mom discovers a tiny LES concert flyer and prepares for her son’s show as though he is headlining Madison Square Garden.
vision.narrativeOverview:
Scene 1: Mom spots CHXNDLER in tiny print on a flyer on the fridge, circles his name, writes SOLD OUT and celebrates; he notices the exaggeration.

Scene 2: Mom wears CHXNDLER merch, makes THAT’S MY SON sign, learns every lyric, practices screaming and dramatically fainting on the couch.

Scene 3: CHXNDLER sings while getting ready in bathroom; Mom appears with sign and phone, cheering and demanding an encore.

Scene 4: Mom sings and dances to his song in kitchen, grabs CHXNDLER and gets him to join her.

Scene 5: Preferred practical version: shoot a real tiny gig if one is scheduled; Mom cheers like an arena. Ultra-low-budget alternative: reveal a one-chair living-room concert.

Scene 6: Mom takes a celebrity-style selfie with CHXNDLER, hugs him, and continues celebrating.
vision.notes:
Source development status: concept_developed — DEVELOPED SOURCE CONCEPT.
Song meaning: A mother believes in her musician son long before the world does. Inspired by childhood rock shows and current Lower East Side gigs.
Visual style notes: Deadpan comedy; natural apartment footage with music-video energy
Mood notes: Funny, loving, celebratory
Signature visual: Tiny local-show flyer treated like Times Square billboard; Mom’s THAT’S MY SON sign
Ending: Mom and CHXNDLER dance/sing together; her stadium-sized pride contrasts with the small reality.

vision.concept: An unseen first-person protagonist navigates an overwhelming day; midway we discover we have been seeing through a dog’s eyes.
vision.narrativeOverview:
Scene 1: First-person camera wakes to light, watches a human prepare breakfast; no dog features revealed.

Scene 2: POV experiences rushing feet, loud noises, a stranger reaching, uncertainty around others; emotional perspective without obvious canine props.

Scene 3: POV approaches CHXNDLER distracted on couch. He looks down, smiles Hey buddy; cut wide for first sight of dog.

Scene 4: Now external shots show dog’s natural hesitations, window watching, toy invitation and CHXNDLER choosing to sit at dog’s level.

Scene 5: Return to dog POV as CHXNDLER looks into lens with affection; no speech necessary.

vision.concept: CHXNDLER falls for an intimidating-looking emo girl who secretly adores cute things and happy dances.
vision.narrativeOverview:
Scene 1: She sits deadpan in black; CHXNDLER sits beside her; she silently sticks a pink heart sticker on his cheek.

Scene 2: She opens a dark closet to reveal one oversized pink plush, hugs it, then solemnly gives him a tiny plush.

Scene 3: She paints his nails black, he puts a pink clip in her hair; they do an absurdly cheerful dance while she keeps a straight face.

Scene 4: They pose for an extremely serious emo selfie; immediately afterward they laugh, kiss and dance.

Scene 5: After CHXNDLER walks away holding her pink heart balloon, she breaks into a tiny uncontrollable happy dance.

vision.concept: Two lovers follow a treasure map toward a ring but choose the joy of being lost together over reaching a prescribed future.

Scene 1: Travel plans reveal a hand-drawn map with an X; couple sets out on treasure hunt.

Scene 2: They follow the map, go the wrong way, dance on beach, laugh and take playful pictures; she admires a ring in a shop window if available.

Scene 3: They find a small box with a ring; she closes it before a proposal and pulls him back toward the ocean.

Scene 4: They realize the cruise ship may be leaving; they start to run, then stop to enjoy the sunset together.

Scene 5: They dance as the map blows across sand, revealing GET LOST WITH ME.

Ending: Missed boat / sunset dance; love was the adventure, not the wedding.
